Terri Pickens for Idaho July 31, 2026 For Immediate Release Terri Pickens Calls on Little to Bring Idaho Guard Troops Home BOISE—Idaho Democratic governor candidate Terri Pickens is calling on Brad Little to bring Idaho National Guard troops home from Washington, D.C. to help fight fires. Pickens issued the call upon news that a Washington, D.C., woman is suing the Idaho National Guard after two Guardsmen allegedly arrested her in her home. “Mr. Little needs to bring Idaho National Guard troops home. They should be nowhere near President Trump’s dangerous and divisive domestic adventures ahead of mid-term elections. We’ll let the courts decide the merits of the $3 million lawsuit filed by a DC woman who claims she was arrested in her home by Idaho Guardsmen. However, if our troops were never loaned out to President Trump to “police” D.C., they’d never have been exposed to this kind of liability.” Pickens noted the governor’s poor decision-making means Idaho’s troops are crucially needed at home to help battle wildfires. “Mr. Little protected his $450 million tax cut for the wealthy instead of funding the Idaho Department of Lands ahead of a vicious fire season that climate scientists and fire managers all warned us about this winter. We need our guardsmen home to help firefighters protect lives, livestock, wildlife, and property. It’s appalling that the Department of Lands has zero dollars in their budget to do their job of fighting wildfire. Mr. Little, bring our guardsmen home!” As of Tuesday, Idaho has had 530 fires that have burned 139,000 acres. ### For more information visit her website: Terri Pickens for Idaho Contact: Dean Ferguson at dean@terriforidaho.com
